The number \(\sqrt2\) is irrational. A rational number has a decimal expansion that either terminates or eventually repeats, whereas an irrational number has an infinite non-repeating decimal expansion. The finite decimal \(1.41421\) is only an approximation.

Thus, the correct answer is E.
